- Thursday 17th – LEGO Club (15:30–16:30) – children's area

On the topic of venues – I've been asked to put together a list of which rooms have reliable HDMI connections for the holiday program. Does anyone know if the meeting room at Central Library Brisbane has been upgraded? Last time I used it, the cable was loose and we had to fiddle with it.

**14:42** — Mia (Children's & Youth)
Good idea. I'll put "weather dependent" on the promotional blurb.

**14:51** — Priya (Program Lead)

**15:04** — Tom (Digital Services)
Great, thanks. I'll confirm the booking.

**15:10** — Mia (Children's & Youth)

**15:12** — Priya (Program Lead)

**15:14** — Sam (Branch Support)

👍 from Mia, Sam, Tom, and Jess.

**09:15** — Mia (Children's & Youth)
Nomination list coming your way by the 20th. I've got a few parents who've been helping with the Lego Club who deserve a shout-out. Also, can we check if the staff room fridge is working? I noticed it was a bit warm on Saturday.

**09:57** — Sam (Branch Support)

**10:22** — Priya (Program Lead)

**10:24** — Mia (Children's & Youth)

**10:25** — Sam (Branch Support)

---

**10:31** — Priya (Program Lead)

**10:46** — Jess (Community Outreach)
Thanks for the update. I'll make sure the volunteers know to use the office fridge if they bring anything in for the morning tea.

---

**10:52** — Tom (Digital Services)
Quick one on the podcast idea – I've sketched out a rough outline. Basically a 30-minute episode, three segments: highlights from the year, a couple of patron interviews, and a look ahead at what's coming in 2025. I can share the doc if anyone wants to add ideas.

**10:54** — Mia (Children's & Youth)
I'd love to add a segment on the Summer Reading Challenge results. We had 1,200 participants this year, up from 980 last year. That's worth celebrating.

**10:55** — Jess (Community Outreach)

**10:57** — Tom (Digital Services)
Nice. I'll add those to the outline and share it by tomorrow morning.

---

**11:03** — Priya (Program Lead)

**11:05** — Sam (Branch Support)
Could do 10:00–11:30 instead. I'll check if the community room is free for that slot.

**11:06** — Jess (Community Outreach)
10:00 works better for me too. I'll adjust the catering quotes accordingly.

**11:08** — Priya (Program Lead)
Thanks both. Let me know once you've confirmed, and I'll update the invite.

---

**11:15** — Tom (Digital Services)
On the subject of next year – I've been thinking about the digital literacy drop-in sessions. We ran them every second Tuesday and attendance was steady but not huge. Average was about 8 people per session. I'd like to try a different format – maybe a themed series, like "online safety" one month and "using your phone camera" the next.

**11:17** — Mia (Children's & Youth)
Themed sounds good. The safety one would probably appeal to parents too – we could cross-promote with the kids' programs.

**11:18** — Jess (Community Outreach)
I like it. Could we also do one session at the community centre rather than the library? Might reach people who don't usually come in.
**11:24** — Sam (Branch Support)
Community room is free 10:00–11:30 on the 28th, just confirmed with front desk. I've put a hold on it. Catering quote from the bakery came in at $185 for the smaller spread – that's for 25 people. Happy to go ahead if everyone's OK with that.

**11:26** — Priya (Program Lead)
Great, thanks Sam. $185 sounds fine. Jess, can you confirm the catering order today so we don't lose the slot?

**11:27** — Jess (Community Outreach)
Done – just emailed them. Moving the morning tea to 10:00–11:30, confirmed.

**11:28** — Priya (Program Lead)
Excellent. I'll update the invite and let volunteers know about the time change. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

---

**11:35** — Tom (Digital Services)
Podcast outline is shared – file name "Podcast Outline v1" in the Programming folder. I've added Mia's SRC segment and Jess's garden group interviews. Also put down a rough running order. Keen for any edits before I start recording intros.

**11:37** — Mia (Children's & Youth)
Looks good. Only thing – can we mention the SRC numbers as "over 1,200 participants" rather than the exact figure? Sometimes exact numbers date quickly if we re-release the episode later.

**11:38** — Tom (Digital Services)
Good point. Changed to "over 1,200" in the outline. Anything else?

**11:40** — Jess (Community Outreach)
I'll send through the garden group interview questions by end of day. They're pretty laid-back, so I've kept the questions simple – more like a chat than an interview.

**11:42** — Tom (Digital Services)
Perfect. That gives me time to edit before the new year.

---

**12:05** — Priya (Program Lead)
Quick update on January programming. The Summer Reading Challenge wrap-up event is booked for Saturday 18 January, 10:00–12:00 in the main hall. Mia, can you confirm the performer for that?

**12:07** — Mia (Children's & Youth)
Yes – "The Bubble Lab" is confirmed for 10:30–11:15, $350 including travel. They did a great job at the school holiday show last year. I'll send the contract through this afternoon.

**12:08** — Priya (Program Lead)
Thanks. And Jess, how are we tracking on the community centre session for the digital literacy series?

**12:10** — Jess (Community Outreach)
Booked for Thursday 23 January, 2:00–3:30. Room holds 20, so we'll cap registrations at 18 to be safe. I've put a poster draft on the shared drive – "Get the Most from Your Phone Camera." Happy for feedback.

**12:12** — Tom (Digital Services)
Poster looks great. One small thing – could we add the library's website on the bottom? I know it's on the other posters but easy to miss.

**12:13** — Jess (Community Outreach)
Good catch. Adding it now.

---

**12:20** — Sam (Branch Support)
Volunteer roster for January is up. A few notes:
- Morning tea on the 28th has been updated to 10:00–11:30, room confirmed.
- Two volunteers have requested time off in the first week of January – I've covered their shifts with casuals.
- We're still short one volunteer for the Saturday 18 January event. I'll put a call out in the volunteer newsletter.

**12:22** — Priya (Program Lead)
Thanks Sam. If we don't get a volunteer by the 10th, I'll see if any of the part-time staff can help out.

**12:24** — Mia (Children's & Youth)
I can help on the 18th if needed – happy to do the check-in table.

**12:25** — Priya (Program Lead)
Noted, thanks Mia. Let's see if we get a volunteer first.

---

**12:30** — Jess (Community Outreach)
Branch update from the Hillside branch – they've had a few requests for a knitting circle in the new year. Is that something we could support with a room booking and some promo?

**12:32** — Priya (Program Lead)
I think so. We've had similar groups at other branches. Sam, can you check room availability at Hillside for a weekly slot, maybe Monday or Wednesday afternoons?

**Date:** Wednesday, 28 August 2024
**Time:** 11:20
**Branch:** New Farm Library
**Location:** Circulation desk
**Description:** Intermittent failure of the public catalogue terminals (3 of 6 affected). Terminals would freeze and require restart. Issue first reported by circulation staff at 11:20.
**Action:** IT Service Desk notified (ticket #IT-88421). Remote diagnosis identified a faulty network switch in the branch server room. Switch replaced by IT field technician at 15:10. All terminals restored by 15:40.

**Action:** Photographs taken and forwarded to Council graffiti removal unit. Removal requested under standard service level agreement (target: 5 working days). Temporary cover not required as graffiti not offensive in nature.

**Incident Log – Facilities Management**

---

**INC-2024-0490**
**Date:** Tuesday, 3 September 2024
**Time:** 09:30
**Branch:** Chermside Library
**Location:** Adult non-fiction shelving, level 2
**Description:** Musty odour reported near the health and wellness section. Patron advised staff the smell had been noticeable for several days. Initial inspection by duty librarian found no visible water staining or mould on carpet or shelving.
**Action:** HVAC maintenance contractor (AirFlow Services) attended 14:00. Ducted return air grille above the section inspected and found to contain a build-up of dust and condensation. Duct cleaned and biocide treatment applied to the grille and surrounding ceiling tiles.
**Resolution:** Odour not detected on subsequent checks over the following week. Section remained open throughout. Incident closed.

---

**Date:** Thursday, 5 September 2024
**Time:** 11:00
**Branch:** Carindale Library
**Location:** Staff room
**Description:** Kitchen sink draining slowly. Staff reported water pooling after washing up.
**Action:** Plumber attended 15:30. Trap and waste line cleared of food debris and grease build-up. Advised staff not to pour cooking oil down the sink.
**Resolution:** Drainage returned to normal. Incident closed.

---

**INC-2024-0494**
**Date:** Tuesday, 10 September 2024
**Time:** 13:00

**Description:** **Update to INC-2024-0488 – renovation.** Fit-out of the new accessible entry and reconfiguration of the children’s area substantially complete. HVAC plant replacement on the roof completed and commissioned. Final inspections scheduled for the week commencing 16 September.
